title: Final synthesis: geometry, collisions and the edge of the theory
promptMarkdown: Write a connected account for a mathematically trained reader. Use these calculations as evidence. (1) Two events have separation $(c\Delta t,\Delta x)=(5L,3L)$, $L>0$. Classify it, compute the inertial connecting clock time and find the boost making them co-located. Explain why an accelerated connecting clock generally differs. (2) Two photons have four-momenta $(E/c,E/c,0,0)$ and $(2E/c,-2E/c,0,0)$. Find the system invariant mass and centre-of-momentum frame velocity; transform each energy to check your result. (3) State the Lorentz-group condition, distinguish a boost from a general Lorentz transformation, and specify the assumptions for conservation of total four-momentum. (4) Interpret controlled free-fall tidal deformation and explain why special relativity alone does not predict the gravitational metric. Include a spacetime sketch for part1 and distinguish exact statements from approximations. Suggested length1000–1600 words; complete clear reasoning matters more than word count.
hintLadder: Square the event separation, then solve $\Delta x\prime=0$.
Square the total four-momentum, not the individual rest masses.
Use $v_{\rm COM}=c^2p_{\rm tot}/E_{\rm tot}$ and transform each photon.
Organise the account around invariants, frame dependence and additional physical hypotheses.
